name: Anu LMS Permissions
description: Adds Group-based permission separation for organisations, teachers and students on top of Anu LMS.
project_description: Submodule of Anu LMS. Integrates the Group module so learning content and members can be scoped to organisations. Ships an 'anu_organization' group type (via feature-exported config), an /organizations listing that redirects when a user belongs to only one organisation, and a custom group canonical view for organisation dashboards (content and membership admin blocks). Adds the user.group_permissions cache context to the Anu LMS normalizer output.
